clauses.why: The drinking and the place are minor detail; the chief deed is that his servant Zimri conspired against and killed him.
clauses.english: was killed by his servant Zimri, who conspired against him
clauses.ukr: був убитий своїм рабом Зімрі, який змовився проти нього
clauses.deu: wurde von seinem Knecht Simri erschlagen, der einen Bund wider ihn machte
clauses.spa: fue muerto por su siervo Zimri, que hizo conjuración contra él

answer.note: The line leaves out that Elah reigned over Israel in Tirzah for two years.
